chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Al-Husayn ibn Al-Mukhtar, from Abu Baseer, who said:
I heard Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) saying: 'The sun has not risen upon a day superior to the day of Friday.'
ai.seo_question: What makes the day of Friday superior in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: Imam Abu Ja'far al-Baqir (peace be upon him) declares Friday the most superior day of the week, a status rooted in Shia tradition as the day of the Prophet's birth, death, and the eventual rise of the Mahdi. This hadith from al-Kafi underscores the day's cosmic significance, encouraging believers to intensify their worship and spiritual preparation for the ultimate victory of justice.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Hammad Bin Isa, from Al Husayn Bin Al Mukhtar, from Abu Baseer who said,
‘I heard Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘The sun has not emerged upon a day superior than the day of Friday’.
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Hammad ibn ‘Isa from al-Husayn ibn al-Mukhtar from abu Basir who has said the following: “
I heard abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, saying, ‘The sun does not shine on anything (other days) more excellent than Friday.”’
